title: mris_curvature_stats
description: Tool for calculating statistics on surface curvature values.

subject_name.description: Subject name defined in the SUBJECTS_DIR
subject_name.title: Subject Name

curvature_files.description: Optional list of curvature files to process
curvature_files.title: Curvature Files

number_of_averages.description: Average the curvature number of times.
number_of_averages.title: Number of Averages

principal_curvatures.description: Calculate principal curvatures and derived maps.
principal_curvatures.title: Principal Curvatures Flag

discrete_method.description: Use discrete calculation method for principal curvatures.
discrete_method.title: Discrete Method Flag

continuous_method.description: Use continuous calculation method for principal curvatures.
continuous_method.title: Continuous Method Flag

signed_principals.description: Assign signed max and min to principal curvature K1 and K2.
signed_principals.title: Signed Principals Flag

vertex_area_weigh.description: Multiply curvature value by the area of its vertex.
vertex_area_weigh.title: Vertex Area Weigh Flag

vertex_area_normalize.description: Divide curvature value by the area of its vertex.
vertex_area_normalize.title: Vertex Area Normalize Flag

vertex_area_weigh_frac.description: Weigh curvature by the fractional vertex area.
vertex_area_weigh_frac.title: Vertex Area Weigh Fractional Flag

vertex_area_normalize_frac.description: Normalize curvature by the fractional vertex area.
vertex_area_normalize_frac.title: Vertex Area Normalize Fractional Flag

post_scale.description: Scale the mean and areaNorm integrals by a factor.
post_scale.title: Post Scale Factor

write_curvature_files.description: Write the calculated curvature values to files in FreeSurfer format.
write_curvature_files.title: Write Curvature Files Flag

shape_index.description: Calculate shape index despite potential atan issues.
shape_index.title: Shape Index Flag

histogram_bins.description: Number of bins for curvature histogram.
histogram_bins.title: Histogram Bins

percentage_histogram_bins.description: Number of bins for percentage-based curvature histogram.
percentage_histogram_bins.title: Percentage Histogram Bins

label_file.description: Label file to constrain statistics to a region.
label_file.title: Label File

regional_percentages.description: Report integral percentages relative to the region.
regional_percentages.title: Regional Percentages Flag

high_pass_filter.description: High pass filter for curvature values.
high_pass_filter.title: High Pass Filter

low_pass_filter.description: Low pass filter for curvature values.
low_pass_filter.title: Low Pass Filter

high_pass_filter_gaussian.description: High pass filter for Gaussian curvature values.
high_pass_filter_gaussian.title: High Pass Filter Gaussian

low_pass_filter_gaussian.description: Low pass filter for Gaussian curvature values.
low_pass_filter_gaussian.title: Low Pass Filter Gaussian

filter_label.description: Store processed surface vertices in a label file.
filter_label.title: Filter Label File

min_max_info.description: Output min/max information for the processed curvature.
min_max_info.title: Min/Max Info Flag

summary_condition.description: Write out stats as a summary condition.
summary_condition.title: Summary Condition

min_curvature_scale.description: Scale curvature values between min and max curvature.
min_curvature_scale.title: Min Curvature Scale

scale_factor.description: Scale curvature values with a factor.
scale_factor.title: Scale Factor

set_zero_vertex.description: Sets the curvature values at that index to zero.
set_zero_vertex.title: Set Zero Vertex

max_ulps.description: Toggle a more rigorous floating point comparison operation.
max_ulps.title: Max Ulps
